Shanghai, 28th November 1944?

No. 466.

The Governor of Ward Road Gaol
Shanghai Municipality 8th District Police Force,
SHANGHAI.

Dear Sir /

I would request you to admit to the Ward
Road Goal the Spanish citizen, FRANCISCO ENDAYA, -
young boy of unsteady character, and has been senten-
ced to three months detention as he was found guilty
of a theft, vagrancy and various other petty offences.
The expenses will be borne by this Consula-
te General.
Thanking you for your cooperation in this
case,

I remain, Dear Sir,
Yours very truly,
José G? de Gregorio.
Chargé d'Affaires for Spain.

FG : IV
Note:- ENDAYA's detention is effective from today,
28th November, for a period of 3 months.

Remarks : - Above mentioned case being in connection
with Loo Ka Wei Station crime No1131/33.
Senior
Detective
